text = text.replace(old, old + '- Fix `--plain` overriding `--paging` and vice versa, while preserving `-pp` paging precedence.\n', 1)
path.write_text(text)

final_message: The root cause was mutual Clap overrides: `--plain` erased `--paging=never`, while reversed arguments erased plain styling. I removed those overrides and preserved `-pp` paging precedence. `peeky probe` confirmed `paging_mode=QuitIfOneScreen` before the fix and `Never` afterward. Added regression tests; paging/plain integration tests and library unit tests pass.
